title: Former UK Tech Adviser Thinks Government Is Failing Startups
summary: The Treasury’s former entrepreneurship adviser has said the government is running out of time to support high-growth startups to drive economic expansion.

title: 95% S&P 500, 5% Bitcoin in New Franklin ETF: Drilldown
summary: Dina Ting, head of index investments at Franklin Templeton, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discuss Franklin US Equity Bitcoin DRIP Index ETF (ticker: FBEQ) and Franklin US Innovation Bitcoin DRIP Index ETF (ticker: FIBT). (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nvidia Board to Probe Spying Case After CEO Jensen Huang Admits Infidelity
summary: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy has sent the company’s stock plunging, become a focus of internal and government investigations and is now threatening to reverberate across the AI industry.

title: Marvell-Lumentum Deal Odds Near Coin Flip as AI Trade Shudders
summary: Marvell Technology Inc.’s plan to double down on AI through a blockbuster $115 billion acquisition of Lumentum Holdings Inc. is getting a lukewarm early verdict from investment experts who bet on deals.

title: Labor Secretary Says Department Looking to 'Modernize' BLS Data
summary: Acting US Labor Secretary Keith Sonderling said that wild swings in jobs data makes the public lose trust in the information coming out of the department and that he is looking to 'modernize' that process. Sonderling also discussed the Trump administration's foreign worker visa policy, saying that the while the visa program is designed to target the 'best and the brightest' it shouldn't come at the expense of American workers.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: 'Fluid Story' With AI, Tech Names: Cinthia Murphy
summary: Cinthia Murphy, investment strategist at TMX VettaFi, and Rob Arnott, chairman & founder of Syzygy Asset Management, join Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Anthropic Unveils New Fable, Mythos AI Models Ahead of IPO
summary: Anthropic PBC has unveiled new versions of its powerful Mythos and Fable artificial intelligence models, an effort to bolster the company’s position as a leader in AI development on the eve of its long-awaited Wall Street debut.

title: Menlo: Agents Now Drive 80% of Enterprise AI Usage
summary: Enterprise AI spending has surged to $177 billion, up from $33 billion in 2025, according to Menlo Ventures’ latest State of Enterprise AI report. Partner Deedy Das says AI agents now account for 80% of usage, as businesses move beyond chatbots toward systems capable of completing complex tasks autonomously. He also discusses the dominance of Anthropic and OpenAI in enterprise API spending. He joins Carol Massar on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nvidia Investor: Governance Now Part of the Valuation
summary: Wealth Enhancement CIO Doug Huber says the fundamental investment case for Nvidia hasn’t changed, but the investigation surrounding CEO Jensen Huang is putting leadership, succession and corporate governance more firmly into the valuation debate. He joins Carol Massar on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nominal Bets on AI for Aerospace and Defense
summary: Nominal has raised new funding at a $3 billion valuation as it builds an AI and data platform for hardware engineering. CEO and cofounder Cameron McCord says revenue has grown more than 3.5-fold in eight months, with customers including five of the world’s seven largest aerospace and defense companies. He joins Carol Massar on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Binance Hackers Made Memecoins to Launder Stolen Crypto
summary: The hackers who stole $6.3 billion from Binance Holdings Ltd. in crypto’s biggest ever heist have turned to one of the sector’s most gimmicky assets to launder a slice of the proceeds: memecoins.

title: Nvidia CEO Affair Draws Washington Scrutiny
summary: Bloomberg’s Carol Massar goes all in on Nvidia's investigation into CEO Jensen Huang after his affair with an alleged Chinese spy, and how the scandal is becoming a Washington national security issue putting the US-China battle over AI chips back in the spotlight. Plus, Menlo Ventures is out with a new report on the state of enterprise AI. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nvidia CEO Probe Prompts Investor Questions, Scrutiny
summary: Shares of Nvidia slumped after Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang admitted to having an extramarital affair with Alice Huang, a woman identified as a suspected Chinese spy. Wall Street experts react on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Meloni Backs Gas Price Cap to Curb Bills Ahead of Italy Election
summary: Italy advanced a plan to reimburse gas-fired power plants for part of their fuel costs, as Premier Giorgia Meloni seeks to stem the impact of a surge in energy prices on households and businesses ahead of a general election next year.

title: EU Plans Crackdown on Addictive Social Media, Bot Features
summary: Social media platforms face a fresh wave of European Union curbs, this time targeting addictive features and artificial intelligence chatbots.

title: US Stocks Extend Oil Relief-Driven Rally Even as Nvidia Sinks
summary: Investors piled into a risk-on relief rally Monday as US President Donald Trump said he’s unlikely to launch broad attacks on Iran, sending oil prices lower.

title: Nvidia Fallout as CEO Faces National Security Scrutiny
summary: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is facing new scrutiny after acknowledging an affair involving an alleged Chinese spy. We break down what the controversy could mean for Nvidia, US and China tensions, the AI trade and Washington oversight, with Admiral James Stavridis and former NSC official Chris McGuire. Plus SharkNinja CEO Mark Barrocas joins us on tariffs, holiday pricing and the rise of AI-powered shopping. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Berkshire Hathaway Boosts Buybacks as Operating Income Slips
summary: Berkshire Hathaway Inc. spent about $9.6 billion to buy back its own shares in the third quarter, a sign the company’s executives viewed the stock as undervalued. But declining insurance underwriting weighed on its operating earnings in a mixed quarter for the company. Bloomberg's Matthew Palazola joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nvidia Spying Probe Raises Thorny Questions For Its Rockstar CEO
summary: Nvidia's probe into Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy is a humbling moment for one of Silicon Valley’s biggest celebrities. Bloomberg's Tom Mackenzie explains why it matters to the entire AI industry. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI Theme Intact, But Market Cycle Has Changed: Thomas
summary: Liz Thomas, chief market strategist at SoFi, says the AI investment theme remains intact even as investors reassess valuations, earnings and capital spending after the recent selloff. “There’s a difference between the theme itself of innovation and what happens in the market and where we are in that market cycle,” Thomas says on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
